raw_segments.text: Polygamy is another physical degradation and a plausible argument for a custom that blasts
every domestic virtue is drawn from the well-attested fact that in the countries where it is established,
more females are born than males.
This appears to be an indication of nature, and to nature apparently reasonable speculations
A further conclusion obviously presents itself.
If polygamy be necessary, woman must be inferior to man and made for him.
